note: Frozen before any source file is opened: universe of cited numbers, match rule, flag taxonomy, known-drift list, seeded-injection design. Sources are only read after this file is written.

match_rule.counts_and_n_G: exact equality after removing thousands separators
match_rule.continuous_and_ci_bounds: |source - reported| <= 0.5 * 10^-d (+1e-9), d = decimals shown in the report; percentages compare source*100 at the shown decimals
match_rule.p_values: equal after rounding the source to the reported significant figures (or 'p < x' holds), AND same side of 0.05, AND same side of the Holm threshold when one is attached to the claim
match_rule.verdicts: the verdict string must equal the one the decision rule gives on the source numbers
match_rule.ci_structure: a reported 'x [lo, hi]' must satisfy lo <= hi and lo <= x <= hi at the shown precision

flags.OK: value/verdict matches its intended source under the match rule
flags.DRIFT_VALUE: a source exists for the intended quantity but the reported value differs and matches no alternative
flags.WRONG_ESTIMATOR: the number is real but comes from a different estimator/spec/model than the one the text names
flags.WRONG_DEFINITION: the number or sentence is real but is given a wrong meaning (e.g. OR read as a risk ratio)
flags.WRONG_FOLD: screen number labelled held-out (or the reverse), or MeSH/main mixed
flags.NOT_TRACEABLE: no file contains the number; a replacement value is given or the number is dropped
flags.VERDICT_DRIFT: the verdict stated differs from what the frozen decision rule gives on the source numbers
flags.MISSING_IN_REPORT: a number of record (hypothesis evidence list / artifact output) that the report never states

known_drift.K01_rq1_rescue_summary: RQ1 rescue in the summary paragraph (line ~7)
known_drift.K02_learned_heading: 'What we have learned' heading rescues RQ1 (line ~867)
known_drift.K14_establishment: 'host-native partners predict establishment' while EST_bin is null

extra_known.K13_constraint_mixed: Table 20c constraint row mixes pooled-panel screen with event-study held-out (review item)

severity_grades.VERDICT-CHANGING: the correct number/verdict changes a significance side, a CI-excludes-null statement or a decision-rule outcome
severity_grades.NUMBER-ONLY: value differs but no conclusion changes

tiers.C: recomputed from row-level files or from primitive quantities (Holm, IVW, counts, prevalences)

seeded_injection.blind: the detector receives only the perturbed text
